persons_tenant_email_key.name: persons_tenant_email_key
persons_tenant_email_key.where: "persons"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "persons"."deleted_at" IS NULL

persons_tenant_document_key.name: persons_tenant_document_key
persons_tenant_document_key.where: "persons"."document_number" IS NOT NULL AND "persons"."deleted_at" IS NULL

persons_document_complete.name: persons_document_complete
persons_document_complete.value: ("persons"."document_number" IS NULL) OR ("persons"."document_type" IS NOT NULL)

announcement_audiences_target.name: announcement_audiences_target
announcement_audiences_target.value:
("announcement_audiences"."audience_type" = 'all' AND "announcement_audiences"."role_key" IS NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."tower_id" IS NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."property_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("announcement_audiences"."audience_type" = 'role' AND "announcement_audiences"."role_key" IS NOT NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."tower_id" IS NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."property_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("announcement_audiences"."audience_type" = 'tower' AND "announcement_audiences"."tower_id" IS NOT NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."role_key" IS NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."property_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("announcement_audiences"."audience_type" = 'property' AND "announcement_audiences"."property_id" IS NOT NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."role_key" IS NULL AND "announcement_audiences"."tower_id" IS NULL)

maintenance_projects_dates.name: maintenance_projects_dates
maintenance_projects_dates.value: "maintenance_projects"."estimated_end_date" IS NULL OR "maintenance_projects"."start_date" IS NULL OR "maintenance_projects"."estimated_end_date" >= "maintenance_projects"."start_date"
